nl.title: Reseller account DirectAdmin
nl.excerpt: Reseller in DirectAdmin: packages, users aanmaken en limieten bewaken.
nl.bodyHtml:
Op reseller-niveau beheer je packages en user-accounts met schijf-, traffic- en domeinlimieten.

Voorbereiding

  • Reseller-login
  • Package-plan

Stappen

  1. Log in als reseller
  2. Open Reseller Level → List Users / Manage Packages
  3. Maak of pas packages aan
  4. Create User met package, e-mail en wachtwoord
  5. Controleer periodiek resource usage

Controleren

  • Nieuwe user logt in op :2222
  • Limieten matchen je aanbod

Tip: Documenteer welk package bij welk klanttype hoort.

Let op: Geef klanten geen admin/root-toegang.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: da-reseller-usage; usage-warning.

en.title: Reseller account DirectAdmin
en.excerpt: Reseller account DirectAdmin: steps in DirectAdmin for reseller, account, DirectAdmin.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Reseller account DirectAdmin. You work in DirectAdmin, focusing on reseller, account, DirectAdmin — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin
  • Focus of this article: reseller, account, DirectAdmin
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in DirectAdmin. Before clicking, note the current value for reseller, account, DirectAdmin.
  2. Select the correct domain/user account in DirectAdmin.
  3. Open the module that fits reseller (Email, DNS, File Manager, SSL, Cron Jobs, MySQL or Installatron).
  4. Note the current status, then apply only what “Reseller account DirectAdmin” requires around account.
  5. Save and test outside DirectAdmin (browser, webmail, DNS lookup or cron log).
  6. Document what you changed around reseller, account, DirectAdmin (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for reseller, account, DirectAdmin matches “Reseller account DirectAdmin”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside reseller account DirectAdmin
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get reseller, account, DirectAdmin right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if reseller, account, DirectAdmin touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin, backups, tickets.
